achievements: Provides a clear historical hypothesis and coefficients that can be regression-tested.
assumptions: Claimed completeness of the tested patterns

contradictions.statement: Math400 corrects the lamellar and BCC interaction coefficients and reverses the selection conclusion.

legacy_conclusion: The main BCC-selection conclusion and part of the coefficient table were later refuted by Math400.
legacy_purpose: Use one-mode interaction coefficients to claim BCC dominance over competitor patterns.
negative_findings: The claimed coefficient ordering and global BCC conclusion do not survive the corrected calculation.
next_actions: Require corrected coefficients and same-reference comparisons in T-055.
no_overclaim: The corrected refutation removes a BCC premise but does not select an alternative physical vacuum.
reusable_elements: Historical coefficient table as a hostile test fixture
title: One-mode BCC coefficient lineage refuted by Math400
